text: Because individual network nodes verify and validate transactions before execution under the distributed consensus model, recording a fraudulent transaction on the blockchain is extremely rare.
citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041
abstract: The distributed consensus model, individual network nodes verify and validate chain transactions before the execution of the transactions, makes it extremely rare for a fraudulent transaction to be recorded in the blockchain.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: requires a distributed consensus model with independent node validation
